title: OceanBench eddy detection
description: One mesoscale eddy of a viewer eddy census frame.

id.description: Detection index, unique within its detection set.

latitude.description: Eddy-centre latitude in degrees north, rounded to 4 decimals.

longitude.description: Eddy-centre longitude in degrees east, rounded to 4 decimals.

contour_latitude.description: Latitudes of the point-limited closed contour polygon (4 decimals). Empty when no valid contour.

contour_longitude.description: Longitudes of the point-limited closed contour polygon (4 decimals), same length as contour_latitude. Not wrapped into the native grid window: on a periodic domain the polygon is traced in an unwrapped frame anchored on the eddy centre, so a contour straddling the grid edge legitimately overhangs it (e.g. 360.5 on a 0..360 grid, -180.0833 on a -180..180 grid). The anchoring keeps every point within one full period of the centre longitude, which bounds the values to the native window widened by 360 on each side.
